correctness.rationale: Write A=v psi and N=u psi uniquely with E u=v and psi(u)=0, E v=v. When u,v independent, w=u-v lies in ker E and v in im E; images containing v but excluding w count q^(r-1)[n-2 choose r-1]_q, and compatible complements contribute q^(r(n-r-1)), giving C_nr=q^(r(n-r)-1)[n-2 choose r-1]_q. For trace A=0 the unique exceptional u=v adds D_nr=q^(r(n-r))[n-1 choose r-1]_q; for nonzero trace no exception. Thus count is (q^(n-1)-1)C or (q^(n-1)-q)C+D. The difference D-(q-1)C>0 in every r, including r=n. Independent direct binary 3x3 exhaustive calculations gave rank-strata tracezero (8,16,1), trnonzero (6,6,0), totals 25 vs 12; the proof establishes all n,q.
